chapters.title: Item 360: everything about one item
chapters.text: This is Item 360. Search any item, to see everything about it in one place: stock, prices, and its history.

chapters.title: Type the item name or group
chapters.text: Type part of the item name, or its group, in the search box.

chapters.title: Tap the item
chapters.text: Each result shows the group, the stock on hand, and the selling price. Tap the one you want.

chapters.title: Stock, prices and history
chapters.text: Here is the full detail: the stock on hand, the prices, and the loss and gain history. Owners can also edit the item here.

chapters.title: ← Back to results
chapters.text: Tap Back to results to look up another item.

chapters.title: Law: find the cause in Item 360 first
chapters.text: Company law: when an item shows a loss, negative stock or a wrong price, open Item 360 and find the cause, a bill, a count, a sale or an edit, before changing anything.

chapters.title: Change item details only to fix a real mistake
chapters.text: Item details are changed only to fix a real mistake, never to hide a loss or make a count match. Breaking a law costs penalty points, and the owner approves every sanction. The laws and this video are on the Laws button.
